reception: To the circuits community the paper is the Raw chip's entry in the record of multicore silicon, cited chiefly as an exemplar: networks-on-chip and multiprocessor system-on-chip surveys list the design when cataloguing tiled interconnects, and low-power on-chip network work differentiates its choices from Raw's. The more engaged citations measure against the chip — AsAP reports comparisons with it, a performance analysis of PIM, stream, and tiled processing exercised it on memory-intensive signal-processing kernels, and knowledge-based STAP algorithm work used it as a platform — while the TILE64 paper discusses the design at length. The record is modest and mostly peripheral, consistent with an implementation paper whose ideas circulate through its companions.
